video.title: Same Bedtime, Same Room. The Screen Lost.

elements.content: On a screen, it took longer to fall asleep.
If you have a condition, ask a clinician
Twelve adults read before bed in a lab,
once on a glowing screen, once on paper.
On the screen, they took nearly ten minutes longer to fall asleep.
So tonight, try paper instead of a screen.
Try it today: one paper book, no screen.
